name: Candice Catering
source:
Candice is a Culinary Witch who wants to use her magic to create memorable experiences for her supernatural clients of zombies, ghosts and more!

A short and sweet VN made for Spooktober 2023 (in spirit).  Features silly dishes, puns, and low stress deductive gameplay. (Aim for a perfect feedback card for a special surprise!)

[From [url=https://blankd.itch.io/candice-catering]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
坎迪斯是一位烹饪女巫，她想用她的魔法为她的僵尸、鬼魂等超自然客户创造难忘的体验！

为Spooktober 2023制作的简短而甜蜜的VN（精神上）。以愚蠢的菜肴、双关语和低压力的演绎游戏为特色。（争取一张完美的反馈卡以获得特别的惊喜！）

[来自[url=https://blankd.itch.io/candice-catering]itch.io[/url]]
